desc: Bosch offers a microwave oven and a convection oven in one complete unit for those looking for an extra cooking area. This unique combination provides quick and convenient cooking with both microwaves and convection.
hl: Flexible cooking with two types of ovens
A combination wall oven is the most versatile cooking option for those who want to customize their oven suite.
Convection Multi-Rack (Convection Pro) for even baking on all racks
Convection Multi-Rack has a third heating element and a fan (regular Convection only has two heating elements) evenly circulates air around the cavity so you get consistently even golden results.
Support heavy dishes with a Telescopic Rack
The telescopic rack moves smoothly and supports heavy dishes and casserole pans with ease, making it effortless to pull out the racks.
No guesswork with a Temperature Probe
Takes the guesswork out of cooking meats.
All Bosch wall ovens install completely flush with your cabinetry, so they blend in beautifully and never protrude.
With all the cooking you'll do in a Bosch oven, clean-up should be your last worry.
spec: 1 x oven racks /lower, 1 x temperature probe /lower
